performance.verdict: Ads are dark; 11 overdue SOW milestones block any launch path.

findings.text: Both paid channels show $0 spend across all 28 days; zero leads generated. No efficiency metric is computable — there is nothing to optimise.

9 CRM/GHL milestones overdue since Jul–Sep 2026: Stripe QA, GHL 5-gap build, Becklar/BWS money-path verification, Offline Conversion Import, CAPI, Paid Landing Pages, UGC Batch, and End-to-End Stack Re-Test. Same root cause: build never handed off to verified.
2 Google Ads milestones overdue Oct 31: 'Optimizing to Activations' and 'Meta Scaling by Activations' plus 'Organic Comparisons Ranking' — all blocked by upstream gaps in F2.

GBP shows 111 impressions over 25 days but 0 calls; call rate is 0. Daily verdict flagged a missing/incorrect phone number — 3-day series (Oct 29–31) shows 0 GBP actions, confirming the 60% WoW drop is now a flat-zero trend, not a blip.

GA4 sessions averaged 16/day last 3 days (Oct 29–31) vs 22/day prior 3 days (Oct 26–28) — modest dip, directional only. With 618 sessions and 0 tracked conversions in 28 days, the site is receiving traffic that produces no attributable outcome.

suggestions.text: Verify and correct the GBP phone number immediately — 111 impressions yielding 0 calls is a confirmed profile error.
